Niu Yuanji was made military commissioner of Shannan East. Vice Minister of War Han Yu was sent to Zhen Prefecture to proclaim comfort. Also an inner attendant bearing credentials entered Shen Prefecture to supervise Yuanji's going to his post. Though Tingcou received appointment, the siege of Shen Prefecture was not lifted. Pacification commissioner Pei Du wrote to You and Zhen with great principle to reprove them. Zhu Kerong lifted the siege and left. Tingcou also withdrew encampment. The court wished them to obey orders and also added Kerong as Acting Vice Minister of Works. In the third month Yuanji led more than ten horsemen to break the siege and leave Shen Prefecture for court. Shen Prefecture commander Zang Ping surrendered the city. Tingcou reproved them for stubborn defense and killed more than one hundred eighty generals and clerks. In the fifth month an inner attendant Yang Zaichang was sent to Zhen Prefecture to take Niu Yuanji's family and Tian Hongzheng's remains. Tingcou said, "Hongzheng's remains—I do not know where they are. Yuanji's family—please wait until autumn for dispatch." Soon Yuanji died. Tingcou then slaughtered his entire family—his cruelty was such. From receiving pardon he then with Zhu Kerong and Shi Xianchang allied in mutual response and plotted to resist the court.
55
太和初，滄州李全略死，其子同捷欲效河朔事，求代父任。 文宗授以兗海節度使； 同捷不奉詔，據郡構逆，以珍玩器幣妓女子弟投款於廷湊及幽州李載義。 時載義初代克融，輸誠效順，盡送同捷所遣赴闕，詔征幽、魏、徐、兗之師進討。 廷湊出兵撓魏北境，以援同捷。 二年，下詔絕廷湊進奉。 既魏博將丌誌治以行營兵叛，倒戈攻魏州，諸軍擊誌治，廷湊出兵應之。 史憲誠危急，詔義武軍節度使李聽擊敗之，誌治奔於廷湊。 三年六月，誅李同捷。 尋又何進滔殺史憲誠，據魏州。 朝廷厭兵，誅之不果，遂授進滔魏博節度。 八月，廷湊遣使詣闕請罪，朝廷因而赦之； 依前檢校司徒、成德軍節度使。
At the beginning of Taihe Cang Prefecture's Li Quanlue died. His son Tongjie wished to imitate the Hebei affair and asked to replace his father. Emperor Wenzong appointed him Yanhai military commissioner. Tongjie would not obey the edict, held the commandery and plotted rebellion, and sent precious objects, utensils, courtesans, sons, and daughters in submission to Tingcou and Youzhou's Li Zaiyi. At that time Zaiyi had just replaced Kerong, offered sincere obedience, and sent all Tongjie's envoys to court. An edict mobilized the armies of You, Wei, Xu, and Yan to advance. Tingcou sent troops to harass Wei's northern border to aid Tongjie. In the second year an edict cut off Tingcou's tribute presentations. When Weibo general Qi Zhizhi rebelled with campaign troops and turned swords to attack Weizhou, the armies struck Zhizhi and Tingcou sent troops to respond. Shi Xianchang was critically pressed. An edict ordered Yiwu military commissioner Li Ting to defeat him. Zhizhi fled to Tingcou. In the sixth month of the third year Li Tongjie was executed. Soon He Jintao killed Shi Xianchang and held Weizhou. The court was weary of war. Execution did not succeed. Jintao was then appointed Weibo military commissioner. In the eighth month Tingcou sent an envoy to court to beg pardon. The court thereby pardoned him. He resumed his former Acting Minister of Works and Chengde military commissionership.
56
鎮冀自李寶臣已來，雖惟嶽、承宗繼叛，而猶親鄰畏法，期自新之路。 而兇毒好亂，無君不仁，未如廷湊之甚也！ 又就加太子太傅、太原郡開國公，食邑二千戶。 八年十一月卒，冊贈太尉，累贈至太師。
Zhen-Ji from Li Baochen on, though Weiyue and Chengzong in succession rebelled, still treated kin and neighbors with fear of law and hoped for the road of self-renewal. Yet for viciousness, love of disorder, lack of lord, and lack of benevolence, none was so extreme as Tingcou! He was further made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Duke of Taiyuan with a fief of two thousand households. In the eleventh month of the eighth year he died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal and repeatedly enfeoffed up to Grand Preceptor.
57
子元逵，為鎮州右司馬，兼都知兵馬使。 廷湊卒，三軍推主軍事，請命於朝。 乃起復檢校工部尚書、鎮州大都督府長史、成德軍節度使，累遷檢校左僕射。 元逵素懷忠順，頓革父風。 及領籓垣，頗輸誠款，歲時貢奉，結轍於途，文宗嘉之。 開成二年，詔以壽安公主出降，加駙馬都尉。 元逵遣段氏姑詣闕納聘禮。 段氏進食二千盤，並禦衣戰馬、公主妝奩及私白身女口等，其從如雲，朝野榮之。 會昌中，昭義節度使劉從諫卒，其子稹擅領軍政； 武宗怒，誅之。 命鄰籓分地而進討，以元逵為北面招討使。 詔至之日，出師次趙州，與魏博何弘敬同收山東三州。 元逵進攻邢州，俄而賊將裴問、高元武降元逵，王釗、安玉降何弘敬，並拔三郡。 累遷檢校司徒、同中書門下平章事。 以破劉稹功，加太傅、太原郡開國公，食邑二千戶，食實封二百戶。 太中十一年二月卒，冊贈太師，謚曰忠。 子紹鼎、紹懿。
His son Yuankui was Zhen Prefecture Right Vice Administrator and concurrent commander of all military affairs. When Tingcou died the three armies pushed him to lead military affairs and asked orders from court. He was recalled from mourning as Acting Vice Minister of Works, chief administrator of the Zhen metropolitan prefecture, and Chengde military commissioner, and was repeatedly promoted to Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs. Yuankui had long harbored loyal obedience and suddenly changed his father's ways. After taking the frontier he quite offered sincere regard. Yearly tribute followed in trains on the road. Emperor Wenzong commended him. In the second year of Kaicheng an edict had Princess Shou'an descend in marriage. He was further made Commandant of the Feathered Forest. Yuankui sent his paternal aunt of the Duan clan to court to present betrothal gifts. Lady Duan presented two thousand trays of food plus imperial robes, war horses, the princess's trousseau, and private attendants. Her retinue was like clouds. Court and countryside honored it. In the Huichang era Zhaoyi military commissioner Liu Congjian died. His son Zhen seized military government on his own. Emperor Wuzong was angry and executed him. An edict ordered neighboring circuits to divide territory and advance in attack. Yuankui was made northern pacification commissioner. On the day the edict arrived he marched and encamped at Zhao Prefecture. With Weibo's He Hongjing he together recovered the three prefectures east of the mountains. Yuankui advanced to attack Xing Prefecture. Soon rebel generals Pei Wen and Gao Yuanwu surrendered to Yuankui. Wang Zhao and An Yu surrendered to He Hongjing. All three commanderies were taken. He was repeatedly promoted to Acting Minister of Works and Co-commissioner of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery. For breaking Liu Zhen's merit he was further made Grand Tutor, Duke of Taiyuan with a fief of two thousand households and a substantive fief of two hundred households. In the second month of the eleventh year of Dazhong he died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor with the posthumous title Zhong. His sons were Shaoding and Shaoyi.
58
紹鼎，時為鎮州大都督府左司馬、知府事、節度副使、都知兵馬使。 起復授檢校工部尚書、鎮府長史、成德軍節度、鎮深冀趙觀察等使，累加光祿大夫、尚書左僕射。 其年七月卒，贈司空，賻布帛三百段、米粟二百碩，累贈司徒、太尉，又贈太傅。
Shaoding was then Zhen metropolitan prefecture Left Vice Administrator, knowing prefectural affairs, deputy military commissioner, and commander of all military affairs. Recalled from mourning he was appointed Acting Vice Minister of Works, Zhen prefecture chief administrator, Chengde military commissioner and commissioner of Zhen, Shen, Ji, and Zhao, and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs. In the seventh month of that year he died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Works with three hundred rolls of cloth and silk and two hundred piculs of grain and millet as funeral gifts, and was repeatedly enfeoffed up to Grand Marshal and Grand Preceptor, then further enfeoffed as Grand Tutor.
59
子景胤、景崇、景敔； 景崇為嫡，時年幼。
His sons were Jingyin, Jingchong, and Jing'ai. Jingchong was the legitimate heir and was still young.
60
紹鼎卒，宣宗以昭王汭為鎮州大都督、成德軍節度副使，都知兵馬使、檢校右散騎常侍、鎮府左司馬、知府事、兼御史中丞，王紹懿本官充成德軍節度、觀察留後，仍賜紫金魚袋。 尋正授節度使、檢校工部尚書。 累加檢校右僕射、兼御史大夫、太原縣開國伯，食邑七百戶，又加檢校司空。 卒，贈司徒。
When Shaoding died Emperor Xuanzong made Prince Zhao Wang the Zhen metropolitan prefect, Chengde deputy military commissioner, commander of all military affairs, Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, Zhen prefecture Left Vice Administrator knowing prefectural affairs and Concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief. Wang Shaoyi in his original office filled Chengde military commissioner and observation acting commissioner and was also granted the gold and purple fish bag. Soon he was formally appointed military commissioner and Acting Vice Minister of Works. He was repeatedly promoted to Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Concurrent Censor-in-Chief, Baron of Taiyuan with a fief of seven hundred households, and further made Acting Minister of Works. He died. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Works.
61
景胤，初為成德軍中軍兵馬使、銀青光祿大夫、檢校太子賓客、監察御史。 紹鼎卒，出為深州刺史、兼殿中侍御史，充本州團練守捉使。
Jingyin was at first Chengde central army cavalry commander, Silver Light Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Acting Crown Prince's Guest, and Investigating Censor. When Shaoding died he went out as Shen prefect and Concurrent Palace Attendant, regimental commander and defense commissioner of that prefecture.
62
景崇，於季父紹懿時為鎮州大都督府左司馬、知府事、都知兵馬使。 紹鼎卒，三軍立紹懿。 數月，疾篤。 召景崇謂之曰：「亡兄以軍政托予，以俟汝成立。 今危惙如此，殆將不救。 汝雖少年，勉自負荷，下禮籓鄰，上奉朝旨，俾吾兄家業不墜，惟汝之才也！」 言訖而卒。 時監軍在席，奏其治命，上嘉之，詔起復忠武將軍、守左金吾衛將軍同正、檢校右散騎常侍，充成德軍節度觀察留後，仍賜上柱國，賜紫金魚袋。 尋正授節度使、檢校工部尚書。
Jingchong, during his uncle Shaoyi's time, was Zhen metropolitan prefecture Left Vice Administrator, knowing prefectural affairs, and commander of all military affairs. When Shaoding died the three armies established Shaoyi. Several months later he was gravely ill. He summoned Jingchong and said to him, "My late brother entrusted military government to me to wait for you to mature. Now I am critically ill like this. I am probably beyond saving. Though you are still young, strive to bear the burden yourself. Treat neighboring circuits with courtesy below and serve court orders above, so that my brother's house and enterprise do not fall—only your talent can do it!" When he finished speaking he died. At that time the supervisor was present. He reported this deathbed command. The emperor commended it. An edict recalled him from mourning as Loyal Martial General, Defender Left Golden Guard General of the same rank, Acting Right Regular Attendant of the same rank, Chengde military observation acting commissioner, and also granted Pillar of State and the gold and purple fish bag. Soon he was formally appointed military commissioner and Acting Vice Minister of Works.
63
咸通中，景崇以公主嫡孫，特承恩渥。 季年，盜起徐方，王師進討，景崇令大將從諸軍。 徐寇平，以功授檢校右僕射，封太原縣男，食邑三百戶。 祖母章惠長公主薨，景崇居喪得禮，朝野稱之。 起復左金吾衛上將軍同正，進位檢校司空。 明年，同中書門下平章事，累加檢校太尉、趙國公，食邑三千戶，食實封二百戶，尋進封常山王。 丁母秦國夫人憂，起復本官。 乾符末，盜起河南，黃巢犯闕，駕幸劍南； 景崇與定州節度使王處存馳檄籓鄰，以兵附處存入關討賊，奔問行在，貢輸相繼。 關輔平定，以功真拜太尉。 中和二年十二月卒。
In the Xiantong years Jingchong, as the princess's legitimate grandson, especially received imperial favor. In his later years bandits rose in Xu region. The imperial army advanced in attack. Jingchong ordered great generals to follow the various armies. When the Xu rebels were pacified, for merit he was appointed Acting Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Baron of Taiyuan with a fief of three hundred households. When his grandmother Princess Zhanghui died, Jingchong observed mourning with propriety. Court and countryside praised it. Recalled from mourning as Left Golden Guard Senior General of the same rank. Promoted to Acting Minister of Works. The next year Co-commissioner of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery. Repeatedly promoted to Acting Grand Marshal, Duke of Zhao with a fief of three thousand households and substantive fief of two hundred households. Soon further enfeoffed as Prince of Changshan. Upon his mother Lady of Qin's mourning he was recalled to his original office. At the end of Qianfu bandits rose in Henan. Huang Chao violated the capital. The carriage fled to Jiannan. Jingchong with Ding Prefecture military commissioner Wang Chucun urgently dispatched proclamations to neighboring circuits, attached troops to Chucun and entered the passes to attack bandits, hurried to the traveling palace, and tribute followed in succession. When Guanzhong was pacified, for merit he was formally appointed Grand Marshal. In the twelfth month of the second year of Zhonghe he died.
64
子镕，時年十歲，三軍推為留後，朝廷因授旄鉞，檢校工部尚書。 時天子蒙塵，九州鼎沸，河東節度李克用虎視山東，方謀吞據； 镕以重賂結納，以修和好。 晉軍討孟方立於邢州，镕常奉以芻糧。 及方立平，晉將李存孝侵镕南部，镕求援於幽州。 幽帥李匡威率眾三萬赴之，存孝退去。 景福元年，镕乘存孝有間於其師，乃出兵攻堯山。 晉帥遣大將李存質來援，大敗鎮人於堯山，死者萬計。 晉人乘勝至趙州，镕復求援於燕。 二年，匡威率眾數萬來援。 會邢州節度使李存孝背其帥據城自固，存孝單騎入鎮州，與镕面相盟約。 俄而李克用自率全師攻存孝，時匡威離鎮後，其弟匡籌奪據其位，匡威退無歸路。 镕感其援助之恩，乃迎入府城，築第以居之，事之如父； 匡威亦盡心裨益，軍中之事，皆為訓練。 是年五月，镕過匡威第，陰遣部下伏甲劫镕； 镕抱持之，镕曰：「公誡止人勿倉卒！ 吾為晉人所困，賴公獲濟，猶吾父也，軍政請公帥之。」 即並轡歸府署，鎮軍拒之，竟殺匡威。 晉人知匡威死，克用自率師至城下； 镕出練二十萬犒勞，修好而退。
His son Rong was then ten years old. The three armies pushed him as acting commissioner. The court thereupon granted the banner and baton and appointed him Acting Vice Minister of Works. At that time the Son of Heaven was in distress. The nine provinces seethed. Hedong military commissioner Li Keyong glared at the east of the mountains and plotted to swallow and hold. Rong with heavy bribes formed ties and cultivated good relations. When the Jin army attacked Meng Fangli at Xing Prefecture, Rong regularly supplied him with fodder and grain. When Fangli was pacified, Jin general Li Cunxiao invaded Rong's southern territory. Rong sought aid from Youzhou. Youzhou commander Li Kuangwei led thirty thousand men to the rescue. Cunxiao withdrew. In the first year of Jingfu, Rong taking advantage of Cunxiao's breach with his commander then sent troops to attack Yaoshan. The Jin commander sent the great general Li Cunzhi to aid. He heavily defeated the Zhen men at Yaoshan. The dead numbered in the tens of thousands. The Jin men pressed the victory to Zhao Prefecture. Rong again sought aid from Yan. In the second year Kuangwei led tens of thousands to the rescue. When Xing Prefecture military commissioner Li Cunxiao turned against his commander, held the city and fortified himself, Cunxiao rode alone into Zhen Prefecture and with Rong faced one another and pledged alliance. Soon Li Keyong personally led the full army to attack Cunxiao. At that time after Kuangwei left his post his younger brother Kuangchou seized his position. Kuangwei retreated with no road of return. Rong, moved by his aid, welcomed him into headquarters, built a residence for him to dwell in, and served him like a father. Kuangwei also gave his whole heart in support. Military affairs were all trained by him. In the fifth month of that year Rong passed Kuangwei's residence and secretly sent subordinates with hidden armor to seize Rong. Rong embraced and held him. Rong said, "My lord, warn your men not to act in haste! I was trapped by the Jin men and relied on you to be saved—you are still like my father. Military government I ask you to command." They then rode side by side back to headquarters. The Zhen army resisted. In the end Kuangwei was killed. When the Jin men learned Kuangwei was dead, Keyong personally led troops to below the city wall. Rong brought out two hundred thousand in white silk to reward the army and made peace and withdrew.
65
及汴宋節度使硃全忠領鄆、青三鎮，兵強天下，遣將葛從周、張存敬寇陷邢、洺二州，乘勝北掠燕、趙。 俄而全忠率親兵薄於城下。 镕倉卒無備，謂賓佐曰：「勢危矣，計將安出？」 判官周式者，率先而對曰：「敵人迫我，兵不能抗，此可以理說耳，請見梁帥圖之！」 式即時出見全忠，全忠逆謂式曰：「爾不必言。 王令朋附並汾，違盟爽信，敝賦業已及此，期於無舍！」 式曰：「公言過矣！ 且公為唐室之桓、文，當以禮義而成霸業。 乃欲窮兵黷武，困人於險難，天下其謂公何！」 全忠喜，引式袂而慰之曰：「前言戲之耳！ 且君為王令計如何？」 式曰：「但修好耳！」 即復見镕，請出牛酒貨幣以犒軍； 仍以镕子昭祚及牙將梁公儒、李弘規子各一人，從昭祚入官於大梁，全忠以女妻昭祚。
When Bian-Song military commissioner Zhu Quanzhong held Yan and Qing circuits and three commands, his troops were strongest in the realm. He sent generals Ge Congzhou and Zhang Cunjing to raid and take Xing and Ming prefectures and, pressing the victory, raided north through Yan and Zhao. Soon Quanzhong led personal troops close below the city wall. Rong in haste was unprepared and said to his staff, "The situation is critical—what plan shall we use?" Judge Zhou Shi was first to reply, "The enemy presses us. Troops cannot resist—this can be addressed with reason. Please let me see the Liang commander and plan it!" Shi immediately went out to see Quanzhong. Quanzhong met him and said, "You need not speak. Lord Wang ordered attachment to Bing and Fen, broke alliance and faith. My army has already reached here—I expect no sparing!" Shi said, "My lord speaks too far! Moreover you are the Tang dynasty's Duke Huan and Duke Wen—you should with ritual and righteousness complete hegemony. Yet you wish to exhaust troops and drown men in hardship—what will the realm say of you!" Quanzhong was pleased, took Shi's sleeve and comforted him, "Earlier words were in jest! Moreover what plan do you have for Lord Wang?" Shi said, "Only make peace!" He then again saw Rong and asked to bring out oxen, wine, goods, and currency to reward the army. Also Rong's son Zhaozuo and yamen generals Liang Gongru and Li Honggui's sons each one person followed Zhaozuo to serve at court in Daliang. Quanzhong gave his daughter in marriage to Zhaozuo.
66
及全忠僭，天下無主； 镕不獲已，行其正朔。 镕累遷至開府儀同三司，守太師、中書令，仍賜「敦睦保定大功臣」、上柱國、趙王，食邑一萬五千戶，食實封一千戶，襲食實封二百五十戶。 偽梁加尚書令，及唐室中興，去偽尚書令之號。 天祐七年，母魏國太夫人何氏卒，起復本官。 十八年，為其大將王德明所殺，至於赤族。 其後事在中興云。
When Quanzhong usurped, the realm had no lord. Rong had no choice but to observe his calendar. Rong was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with privilege to open an office, Defender Grand Preceptor, Director of the Chancellery, and was also granted "Great Meritorious Minister of Harmonious Assurance," Pillar of State, Prince of Zhao, fief of fifteen thousand households, substantive fief of one thousand households, and inherited substantive fief of two hundred fifty households. False Liang added Director of the Department of State Affairs. When the Tang dynasty revived, the false Director of the Department of State Affairs title was removed. In the seventh year of Tianyou his mother Grand Lady of Wei, Lady He, died. He was recalled to his original office. In the eighteenth year he was killed by his great general Wang Deming, down to extermination of the clan. Later affairs are in the Restoration.
67
贊=史臣曰：土運中微，群盜孔熾。 寶臣附麗安、史，流毒中原，終竊土疆，為國蟊賊。 加以武俊之狠狡，為其腹心，或叛或臣，見利忘義，蛇吞蝮吐，垂二百年。 哀哉，王政不綱，以至於此。 若使明皇不懈於開元之政，姚崇久握於阿衡，詎有柳城一胡，敢窺佐伯，況其下者哉！ 觀此無君，可為太息。
Comment: The historians say: Earth's fortune declined in the middle; bandits were greatly rampant. Baochen attached to An and Shi, spread poison through the central plains, and in the end stole territory and became a plague to the state. Add Wujun's fierce cunning as his inner heart—now rebel, now minister, forgetting righteousness for profit, snake swallowing and viper spitting—for nearly two hundred years. Alas, royal government lacked discipline, until it came to this. If Emperor Ming had not slackened Kaiyuan government and Yao Chong long held the balance—how could a single Hu of Liucheng dare gaze at the chief minister, how much less those below! Seeing this lack of lord, one can only sigh deeply.
68
贊曰：鵂鹠為怪，必取其昏。 人君失政，為盜啟門。 牙旂金鉞，虎子狼孫。 茫茫黔首，於何叫閽？
Praise says: When the owl demon acts strange, it must take the confused. When the ruler loses government, he opens the door to bandits. Banner staffs and golden axes—tiger sons and wolf grandsons. The boundless black-haired people—to whom shall they cry at the gate?
